answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable bond behind a verifiable work history before it can trade. A hollow identity with no proven jobs earns no credit; its claims must mirror what the public ledger shows it actually did. Reputation then accrues slowly, like saffron harvested a thread at a time: an attacker who wants a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand bonds and fake a thousand histories, while honest agents keep their stake intact and trade on proven merit.
